title: 第28章 各方反应
novel_title: 穿越源卡大陆，我自带融合卡牌
content_zh:
与城主府的淡然相比，万卡阁那边得到消息后可就沸腾了。

    “蓝色品质的卡牌？还有三张？！你确定自己没有弄错？”

    菲奥娜猛地一拍红木长桌，精致的妆容都因激动而添了几分厉色。

    站在下方的莱德连忙挺直腰板，眼神却不自觉地瞟过菲奥娜因动作而起伏的胸前，咽了口唾沫才回道：

    “是啊，大执事，此事千真万确！现在整个佣兵圈子都传疯了，各大佣兵团的人都往奇妙物语商铺赶，想参加今天下午的卡牌购买。”

    菲奥娜一脸震惊，如果佣兵团都回城了，那么这件事九成是真的。

    还有一成原因就是林峰想被大卸八块，这才戏耍了所有人。

    “林峰，林峰……”

    菲奥娜对于这个男人的确有些印象，除了对方是四星御卡师外，还有个原因就是他每次来购买卡牌时，都会死死盯着自己看。

    菲奥娜知道自己很美，也充分的利用了自己的优势，一般她在万卡阁闲逛时，客流量都会增加。

    但其他人都是偷偷的看，还装一装绅士，可林峰完全不一样，那种目光太有攻击性了，仿佛能透视自己的身体一样。

    “他会是制卡师？”

    想到林峰每次来万卡阁除了闲逛和欣赏自己，却从来没见他买过一张卡牌。也就是最近他儿子林奇开始大量购买卡牌，之后林峰的店铺就开始售卖卡牌了。

    将这一连串的信息放在一起，菲奥娜突然得出了一个结论，林峰是制卡师！

    “怪不得他每次来万卡阁都不买卡牌，原来是参考我万卡阁的卡牌，从而做出品质更好的卡。”

    菲奥娜低头看着桌面上的两把佣兵佩剑，一柄是万卡阁自产的，一柄是从佣兵手里买来的。

    而这佣兵从奇妙物语商铺买到佩剑，的确要比万卡阁卖的更为锋利。

    “莱德，去把凯恩叫来。”

    凯恩？

    莱德眼神一冷，他最近可是烦透这个凯恩了。

    如今菲奥娜叫他前来，自己的地位显然下降了啊！

    “还愣着干嘛？”

    “哦，是。”

    ……

    奇妙物语商铺内。

    林奇这一觉睡得格外沉。
content_en:
Compared with the indifference of the City Lord's Mansion, Wanka Pavilion was filled with excitement after receiving the news.

    "Blue quality cards? There are three more?! Are you sure you are not mistaken?"

    Fiona slammed the long mahogany table, and her delicate makeup was a little more intense with excitement.

    Ryder, who was standing below, quickly straightened his back, but his eyes unconsciously glanced at Fiona's chest that rose and fell due to the movement, and he swallowed before replying:

    "Yes, Archdeacon, this is absolutely true! Now the whole mercenary circle has gone crazy. People from all major mercenary groups are rushing to the Wonder Story store to participate in the card purchase this afternoon."

    Fiona looked shocked. If the mercenary group had returned to the city, then this matter was 90% true.

    Another 10% reason is that Lin Feng wanted to be cut into pieces, so he played a trick on everyone.

    "Lin Feng, Lin Feng..."

    Fiona did have some impression of this man. In addition to the fact that he was a four-star card master, another reason was that every time he came to buy cards, he would stare at her.

    Fiona knew that she was beautiful and made full use of her advantages. Usually when she wandered around Wanka Pavilion, the traffic would increase.

    But others were watching secretly and pretending to be gentlemen, but Lin Feng was completely different. His gaze was so aggressive, as if he could see through his own body.

    "Will he be a card maker?"

    I thought that every time Lin Feng came to Wanka Pavilion, apart from hanging out and admiring himself, he had never bought a card. That is to say, his son Lin Qi recently started buying cards in large quantities, and then Lin Feng's store began to sell cards.

    Putting this series of information together, Fiona suddenly came to the conclusion that Lin Feng was a card maker!

    "No wonder he doesn't buy cards every time he comes to Wanka Pavilion. It turns out that he refers to my Wanka Pavilion's cards to make better quality cards."

    Fiona looked down at the two mercenary swords on the table. One was produced by Wanka Pavilion, and the other was bought from a mercenary.

    And the sword that the mercenary bought from the Wonderful Story store was indeed sharper than the one sold by Wanka Pavilion.

    "Ryder, go get Kane."

    Kane?

    Ryder's eyes turned cold. He was really tired of Kane recently.

    Now that Fiona asked him to come, his status has obviously declined!

    "Why are you still standing there?"

    "Oh, yes."

    …

    Inside the Wonderful Story store.

    Lin Qi slept extremely deeply this time.
